title: Spicy Yogurt Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, trimmed and separated into florets
directions: Preheat oven to 425˚. Whisk together olive oil and next 8 ingredients; set aside.
Arrange cauliflower on a lightly greased aluminum foil-lined baking sheet. Bake at
425F for 12-15 or until golden, stirring once after 6 minutes. Transfer pan to
wire rack. Drizzle cauliflower with olive oil mixture; toss gently. Serve immediately.
